hooks.command: $input = $null; try { $input = $args[0] } catch {}; $json = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $cmd = ($json | ConvertFrom-Json).tool_input.command; $blocked = @('git add', 'git commit', 'git push'); foreach ($b in $blocked) { if ($cmd -match ('^' + [regex]::Escape($b))) { @{ continue = $false; stopReason = "Blocked: '$b' is not allowed. Please run git commands manually." } | ConvertTo-Json; exit 0 } }; exit 0

$json = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $data = $json | ConvertFrom-Json; $fp = if ($data.tool_input.file_path) { $data.tool_input.file_path } elseif ($data.tool_input.path) { $data.tool_input.path } else { '' }; if ($fp -eq '') { exit 0 }; $cwd = (Get-Location).Path.Replace('\', '/'); $fp_norm = $fp.Replace('\', '/'); if (-not $fp_norm.StartsWith($cwd)) { @{ continue = $false; stopReason = "Blocked: file '$fp' is outside the working directory '$cwd'." } | ConvertTo-Json; exit 0 }; exit 0
